title: Offensive Hebrew Corpus and Detection using BERT

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating a Hebrew Twitter corpus for hate speech and offensive language directed at ethnic groups (e.g., Arabs, Jews) and evaluating the detection accuracy of fine-tuned BERT models.

Collecting tweets using keywords related to national groups and conflicts (e.g., Palestinians, Israel) and training language models to classify text containing offensive language against these targets.
Identifying offensive tweets using religion-related keywords (e.g., Muslim, Islamist) and evaluating transformer-based models on their ability to detect this hateful content.
Labeling offensive language targeting political figures and groups (e.g., Netanyahu, Left Wing, Arab parties) to test the classification performance of fine-tuned BERT models.
